Amazon.Child's attribute set ⊇ parent's?: n/a — no tree on the attribute owner (ProductType has 3 properties, flat); browse-node refinements: 219 of 237 parent→child pairs superset, 18 not.
Amazon.Override / removal mechanism: none named; the meta-schema's 12 keywords contain no override/exclusion keyword (first-party 2026-09-21).

Shopify.Child's attribute set ⊇ parent's?: no — materialised per node; the child often drops: 4,668 of 14,580 pairs (4,877 live); inherit → 0 in 95 MB. 97.8 % of internal nodes carry ≥1 attribute, so this is a real “no”.
Shopify.Override / removal mechanism: the child's own list is authoritative, enforced at write: “Owner subtype does not match the metafield definition's constraints.”

Google.Override / removal mechanism: requiredness has an enumerated prose exception list: 16 Apparel sub-categories Optional where ancestor 166 is Required.

eBay.Override / removal mechanism: category features: yes — “override” is eBay's own word and the wire format is built on it.
eBay.Other kinds of fact that flow: category features (tree-wide) inherit; aspects (leaf-only) do not — per kind of fact.

Walmart.Child's attribute set ⊇ parent's?: n/a — flat; additionalProperties: false on every type.

Shopee.Child's attribute set ⊇ parent's?: no inheritance mechanism at all (0 hits across 5 MB).

Tokopedia.Child's attribute set ⊇ parent's?: n/a — bound to one leaf; non-leaf nodes cannot be queried for attributes.

Square.Other kinds of fact that flow: online_visibility is forced down: the parent's write rewrote the child row (same updated_at to the ms) — observed, stated in no vendor text.

Salesforce B2C.Child's attribute set ⊇ parent's?: yes — global groups ∪ the classification category's groups ∪ “any parent categories” (single route).
Salesforce B2C.Override / removal mechanism: override by id collision: “the sub-category group overrides the parent group”; removal never stated.

Akeneo.Child's attribute set ⊇ parent's?: yes on the Family tree (SaaS, “Attribute Inheritance”); category tree: none; FamilyVariant levels hold disjoint sets — values flow, definitions do not.
Akeneo.Override / removal mechanism: an inherited attribute cannot be removed while linked (detach → edit parent → re-attach); completeness requirements cannot be overridden.

WooCommerce.Child's attribute set ⊇ parent's?: neither — a term carries no definitions.
WooCommerce.Override / removal mechanism: unset display_type/thumbnail_id fall back to a site option, never the parent.

Magento.Child's attribute set ⊇ parent's?: no — attribute sets are flat (4 columns, no parent); 0 of 63 tables join a category to a product attribute.
Magento.Override / removal mechanism: attribute-set “Based On” copies once with no standing link; category EAV has per-node is_anchor, custom_use_parent_settings.
